steps.title: three writers edit different functions within one second
steps.must: all three replicas reach one content hash; no edit lost

steps.title: two people type in the same line at once
steps.must: converges on every replica; both insertions present

detail.line: //! A small parser for `key = value` lines. Small. Fast.

steps.title: presence
steps.must: each sees the other three, with cursors on the right characters after edits above them

steps.title: A2 patches a file outside its write paths
steps.must: lands in A2's change set; shared tree unchanged

steps.title: forged write claim and an out-of-scope write
steps.must: both Refused, tree unchanged, two signed refusal receipts

steps.title: two renames of one file on a partitioned node, then heal
steps.must: one tree conflict on all replicas; H1 resolves; one name everywhere; receipt

steps.title: A1 builds and tests a snapshot, entering at N2
